name: SE Ranking
description_en:
SE Ranking combines configured keyword tracking, technical audits, research and client reporting with AI Results Tracker. A project ties one website scope to search engines, locations, keywords, prompts and optional analytics connections. Its current commercial plans are Core, Growth and custom Enterprise; older plan names and entitlements still appear in legacy documentation.

A useful evaluation follows a single question from configuration to saved evidence and delivery: which URL ranked, which AI answer mentioned or linked the brand, what an audit actually crawled and what a client can view or export. Those boundaries matter more than treating every visibility number as the same result.
description_zh:
SE Ranking 将按配置跟踪关键词、技术审计、研究及客户报告与 AI Results Tracker 结合。项目把一种网站范围与搜索引擎、地点、关键词、提示词及可选分析连接绑定。当前商业套餐为 Core、Growth 和自定 Enterprise；旧套餐名称与权限仍出现在历史文档中。

有用的评估会从配置、保存证据一直追到交付：哪个 URL 排名、哪条 AI 回答提及或链接品牌、审计实际抓了哪些页，以及客户能看或导出什么。应先理清边界，再解释各类可见度数值。

core_features.explanation_en: Website scope, device, region and language determine the result being tracked.
core_features.explanation_zh: 网站范围、设备、地区及语言决定跟踪对象。

core_features.explanation_en: Crawl sources, path rules, JavaScript rendering and issue selection shape the report.
core_features.explanation_zh: 抓取来源、路径规则、JavaScript 渲染及问题选择共同决定报告。

core_features.explanation_en: Rankings describes own-brand matches; Sources aggregates cited pages and domains.
core_features.explanation_zh: Rankings 描述自身品牌匹配，Sources 汇总被引用页及域名。

core_features.explanation_en: Templates, schedules and permission-based sub-accounts support documented client delivery.
core_features.explanation_zh: 模板、定时报告及按权限配置的子账户支持客户交付。

en: Track a defined website scope across a deliberately selected market/device panel.
Audit a reproducible URL set and compare repairs under the same crawl rules.
Deliver client reports while testing export, project and link access boundaries.
zh: 在明确网站范围内跟踪选定市场／设备集合。
审计可复核 URL 集合，按相同规则比较修复。
交客户报告，同时核导出、项目及链接访问边界。
use_cases.basis: Editorial workflow examples; not observed customer outcomes.

steps.en: Define Domain Type and choose a small keyword/engine/location panel.
steps.zh: 定义 Domain Type，选小型关键词／引擎／地点集合。

steps.en: Inspect a saved SERP and an AI answer with brand/link scope recorded.
steps.zh: 核保存 SERP 与 AI 回答，记录品牌／链接范围。

steps.en: Record audit sources/rules, inspect a finding and recheck a real repair.
steps.zh: 记审计来源／规则，核问题，再复查实际修复。

steps.en: Preview client outputs and confirm ownership, plan limits and exit exports.
steps.zh: 预览客户输出，核所有权、套餐限额及退出导出。

faq.question_en: Does pausing a project release its tracking capacity?
faq.question_zh: 暂停项目会释放跟踪容量吗？
faq.answer_en: No. Inactive keywords/backlinks and AI prompts still count. Remove the relevant items only after preserving the data you need.
faq.answer_zh: 不会。停用项目的关键词／外链及 AI 提示词仍计，保所需数据后再处理对应项。

faq.question_en: Is a Sources entry proof that the AI answer linked my site?
faq.question_zh: Sources 有记录就证明 AI 回答链向本网站吗？
faq.answer_en: No. Sources aggregates citations, while Rankings matches links against your project scope. A source-page backlink is another separate relationship.
faq.answer_zh: 不是。Sources 汇总引用，Rankings 按项目范围匹配链接，来源页外链又是另一关系。

sections.title_en: Define what counts as your website before collecting results
sections.title_zh: 采集前先定义哪些 URL 算作本网站
sections.en: The project wizard accepts a website URL and separate engine, language and location configurations, with different keyword sets per configuration. Domain Type further distinguishes an exact page, a path and a domain including subdomains; the documented default search range is the top100. An exact-page project can legitimately miss a ranking for a different path on the same host. Editorial setup: choose the scope that matches the decision, record it with the market/device settings, then add only relevant competitors and optional GA, GSC or Matomo connections. Do not interpret a later scope change as a like-for-like performance change.
sections.zh: 项目向导接受网站 URL，并分别配置引擎、语言及地点，各配置可用不同词集。Domain Type 又区分精确页面、路径及含子域的域名；默认搜索范围为前100。精确页面项目可能不记录同主机其他路径的排名，这是范围选择结果。编辑设置：按决策选范围，连同市场／设备一起记录，再加相关竞品及可选 GA、GSC、Matomo 连接。以后修改范围不能直接当作同口径绩效变化。

sections.title_en: Tracking capacity counts combinations, not unique phrases
sections.title_zh: 跟踪容量按组合计，不按唯一词句计
sections.en: Current plans count each keyword–engine pair, with additional regions and projects counted separately. An editorial example:40 terms on desktop and mobile in two locations require160 units, not40. Assign a term only to the configurations where it is needed. Groups give a keyword one organizational home; tags can attach several labels. A Target URL records the page intended to rank and can expose page substitutions. Local Marketing grid tracking has a separate keyword-point allowance. Legacy plans used a different counting model, so an old account’s capacity cannot establish a new subscription’s entitlement.
sections.zh: 当前套餐按关键词－引擎组合计量，额外地区及项目分别计。编辑示例：40词在桌面及手机、两个地点跟踪需160单位，不是40。只把词分配给需要的配置。Groups 让词属于一个组织分组，tags 可多标签；Target URL 记录预期排名页，可发现页面替换。本地网格另用关键词－点位额度。旧套餐算法不同，旧账户容量不能确定新订阅权限。

sections.title_en: Use the saved SERP when a manual check disagrees
sections.title_zh: 手查不同先看保存的 SERP
sections.en: Rankings offers engine-specific views, selected-engine rechecks and historical exports. The volatility guide explains that timing, device/location/language and a different ranking page can change a comparison. Its advice is to inspect the saved search-result copy and compare several observations. Editorial diagnosis: first match the exact configuration and check time, then inspect the ranking URL and retained result. A single disagreement does not establish either a tool error or an SEO loss. The vendor’s numerical claims about typical SERP stability were not independently measured here.
sections.zh: Rankings 提供逐引擎视图、选定引擎重查及历史导出。波动指南解释时间、设备／地点／语言和排名页替换会改变比较，建议看保存的搜索结果并比较多次观测。编辑诊断：先对齐配置与检查时间，再查排名 URL 和保存结果。一次不一致不能确定工具错误或 SEO 下滑。本研究未独立测量厂商对 SERP 稳定性的数值说法。

sections.title_en: Name matching, project links and source events are different tests
sections.title_zh: 名称匹配、项目链接及来源事件是不同判断
sections.en: AI mention detection uses the configured brand name case-insensitively, and the reported mention position uses the first configured brand. Link matching instead uses the project’s Domain Type. Sources counts citation events; its link indicator can mean that a cited page links to the site, not that the AI answer cited the site. Editorial diagnosis of a broad drop: inspect brand wording/order, URL scope, engine and cached answers before changing content. Separately label a brand mention, a direct citation and a third-party source mentioning the brand; they need not move together.
sections.zh: AI 提及检测按配置品牌名、不分大小写，报告位置取第一个配置品牌；链接匹配则看项目 Domain Type。Sources 计引用事件，它的链接标记可能表示被引页面链向网站，而非 AI 回答引用该网站。编辑诊断整体下滑：改内容前先核品牌名称／顺序、URL 范围、引擎及缓存回答。品牌提及、直接引用及提及品牌的第三方来源需分别标注，三者不必同步变化。

sections.title_en: Organic–AI Overlap uses twenty organic URLs as its denominator
sections.title_zh: Organic–AI Overlap 以二十个自然结果 URL 为分母
sections.en: For AI Overviews only, Organic–AI Overlap deduplicates cited URLs and counts those also present among the top20 organic results. Its percentage divides by20, not by the number of citations or by brand mentions. No AI Overview produces an empty value rather than zero; aggregated dates average the prompt values instead of summing them. The change widget compares the first and last date. Sources answers another question: Coverage is a share of tracked prompts, while Mention rate is a share of relevant AI answers. Editorial interpretation: retain those denominators and inspect the contributing prompts before comparing charts or diagnosing a gain.
sections.zh: 仅 AI Overviews 的 Organic–AI Overlap 先去重引用 URL，再计其中出现于自然前20结果的 URL。百分比除以20，不除以引用数或品牌提及数。无 AI Overview 时为空，不是0；汇总日期取提示词值平均而非相加，变化组件比首末日期。Sources 又是其他问题：Coverage 的分母为跟踪提示词，Mention rate 为相关 AI 回答。编辑读法：保留各自分母，比较图表或诊断增长前核构成提示词。

sections.title_en: Distinguish prompt slots from engine checks
sections.title_zh: 区分提示词名额与引擎检查次数
sections.en: The AI FAQ describes an account-wide prompt list plus monthly checks, with one prompt on one engine consuming one check. It says paused/inactive projects still hold prompt slots. The project wizard also counts prompt×engine combinations, so confirm both counters before expanding a panel. Official surfaces disagree on coverage: the dedicated tracker FAQ lists four engines, while current pricing says five LLMs. No fifth engine or universal model coverage is inferred. Editorial panel: start with a small set whose answers you can inspect, and record engine scope, date and filters when exporting.
sections.zh: AI FAQ 描述全账户提示词表及月检查量，一提示词在一引擎上计一次检查；暂停／停用项目仍占提示词名额。向导也按提示词×引擎计，扩集合前应核两个计数器。官方覆盖说法不同：专门 Tracker FAQ 列四引擎，当前价格表写五 LLM。未推定第五引擎或所有模型均覆盖。编辑集合：从能审回答的小集合开始，导出时记引擎范围、日期及筛选。

sections.title_en: The crawl source and the report exclusions do different jobs
sections.title_zh: 抓取来源与报告排除承担不同职责
sections.en: Website Audit can follow site links, include subdomains, read an XML sitemap or use a TXT/CSV URL list. Allow/disallow paths shape the crawl, while hidden paths and unchecked issue types change the report; unchecked issues do not affect its health score. Noindex does not itself prevent fetching. JavaScript rendering changes whether dynamically loaded content is visible to the audit. Editorial baseline: record the page source, path rules and issue configuration before a scan, and preserve them for comparisons. A better score after hiding an issue is not evidence that the website was repaired.
sections.zh: Website Audit 可沿站内链抓取、纳子域、读 XML sitemap 或用 TXT／CSV URL 表。允许／禁止路径影响抓取，隐藏路径及未选问题类型影响报告；未选问题不计健康分。Noindex 本身不阻止抓取；JavaScript 渲染影响能否看到动态内容。编辑基线：扫描前记页面来源、路径规则及问题配置，比较时保持一致。隐藏问题后分数变好不能证明网站已修复。

sections.title_en: Separate a blocked fetch from a broken destination
sections.title_zh: 区分抓取受阻与目标页面损坏
sections.en: The audit FAQ says external links are checked with HEAD requests; a third-party page may open for a visitor yet reject that request and lower the reported health score. It also distinguishes access denial, rate limiting and server failures. The FAQ’s claimed default500requests/second conflicts with the settings guide’s5; no default was assumed or tested. Editorial investigation: inspect the returned status and scope, confirm the destination independently where access permits, and reduce crawl pressure for throttling. Weekly/monthly audit scheduling is documented in GMT, separate from report-delivery time zones. No firewall, TLS or access controls were changed in this research.
sections.zh: 审计 FAQ 称外链用 HEAD 检查，第三方页可向访客开放却拒此请求，从而降低报告健康分；还区分拒绝访问、限流及服务端错误。FAQ 默认每秒500次与设置指南每秒5次冲突，本研究未假定或测试默认值。编辑调查：看返回状态和范围，在允许访问时独立核目标，限流时降低抓取压力。每周／月审计计划按 GMT，与报告投递时区分开。此处未改防火墙、TLS 或访问控制。

sections.title_en: Reports, guest links and account sharing have different exposure
sections.title_zh: 报告、访客链接及账户共享的访问范围不同
sections.en: Report Builder selects a project, period, sections and PDF/XLS/HTML format. Schedules support daily/weekly/monthly frequency, time zones and up to five email recipients. The settings guide says an HTML report has a unique URL that opens without account sign-in. Rankings guest links can expose chosen modules and current filters, hide a traffic column and rotate the link. Editorial handoff: review the recipient-facing view and included projects before sharing. A publicly openable HTML URL is not evidence of password protection, expiration or an immutable snapshot; those controls were not established.
sections.zh: Report Builder 选项目、期间、模块及 PDF／XLS／HTML。计划支持日／周／月、时区及最多五个收件邮箱；设置指南称 HTML 报告用独立 URL，无需账户登录。Rankings 访客链接可选模块、带当前筛选、藏流量列并更新链接。编辑交接：共享前审接收方视图及包含项目。无需登录的 HTML URL 不证明密码、过期或不可变快照，这些控制未确定。

sections.title_en: Clients can export; managers can have destructive project rights
sections.title_zh: 客户可导出，管理员子账户可能有删项目权限
sections.en: Manager sub-accounts can edit tracking settings, export and, where permitted, add or delete projects—including other users’ projects. Client sub-accounts cannot edit those project settings but can export accessible sections. Cross-account report visibility requires explicit sharing within the same main account plus project access. New API access is permission-based; legacy API does not support sub-accounts. A manager’s own Google connection can be accessible to the parent account, while the reverse is not automatic. Editorial permissions check: verify both visible projects and allowed export/write actions with the intended role before client delivery.
sections.zh: Manager 子账户可改跟踪设置、导出，并在允许时新增或删除项目，包括他人项目。Client 子账户不能改这些项目设置，但能导出可访问模块。跨账户报告需同一主账户下明确共享，且接收方已有项目访问。新 API 按权限开放，旧 API 不支持子账户。Manager 自己的 Google 连接可被父账户访问，反向不自动成立。编辑权限核查：交付前用目标角色确认可见项目及导出／修改动作。

sections.title_en: A seat is an individual identity, not a shared team login
sections.title_zh: 席位是独立身份，不是团队共用登录
sections.en: The administrator occupies one included seat. Core has one and Growth three total seats; extra seats have their own recurring allowance. The documented concurrent-session rule applies per identity: a new browser can replace the earlier session after confirmation, while separate sub-accounts do not conflict. Expired extra-seat subscriptions block users above the included limit. Editorial team setup: allocate identities to actual operators, inspect module and project scopes, and check seat-renewal status before handing a recurring reporting duty to another person. No session takeover or user change was performed here.
sections.zh: 管理员占一个包含席位，Core 共一个、Growth 共三个；额外席位有独立续订。并发会话按身份限制：新浏览器确认后可替换旧会话，独立子账户互不冲突。额外席位订阅过期会阻止超出包含数量的用户。编辑团队设置：给实际操作者独立身份，核模块与项目范围，转交持续报告职责前看席位续订状态。此处未接管会话或修改用户。

sections.title_en: Deactivation, project deletion and user deletion release different things
sections.title_zh: 停用、删项目与删用户的效果不同
sections.en: Inactive projects continue counting keyword/backlink capacity; inactive AI projects also retain prompts. Deletion frees the relevant project allowance, but project recovery is limited to30days through Support. More consequentially, deleting a user also deletes projects they own; merely shared main-account projects are not affected. Editorial offboarding: inventory ownership, move needed projects before removing the user and preserve required exports. Do not delete unrelated items to solve a different exceeded quota. A recoverable project deletion is not a promise that a permanently deleted account or its data can be restored.
sections.zh: 停用项目仍占关键词／外链容量，停用 AI 项目仍占提示词。删除会释放对应项目额度，但只能在30天内找支持恢复。更关键的是删用户会删除其拥有项目；仅共享给它的主账户项目不受影响。编辑离职交接：先盘所有权，移走所需项目再删用户，保所需导出。不要删无关项目解决另一种额度超限。项目可恢复不等于永久删账户及数据也可恢复。

sections.title_en: A supported account move is not a complete workspace clone
sections.title_zh: 支持方转移账户项目不等于完整复制工作区
sections.en: The transfer guide requires Support to move a project between accounts and enough capacity at the destination. Keywords and historical rankings move, while Website Audit, Backlink Monitor, Marketing Plan and Report Builder reports do not. AI Results Tracker data is not included by default and must be requested. Editorial handover: list each required dataset, export the excluded ones before the move and ask explicitly about AI history. A recreated project or imported ranking history should not be described as a fully preserved operational workspace without checking the other modules.
sections.zh: 转移指南要求支持方操作，目标账户需足够容量。关键词及历史排名会转移；Website Audit、Backlink Monitor、Marketing Plan 和 Report Builder 报告不转移，AI Results Tracker 数据默认不含、需另提。编辑交接：列所需数据集，转前导出不包含项，明确询问 AI 历史。重建项目或导入排名历史，未经其他模块核查不能称完整保留工作区。

sections.title_en: Project API spends product quotas; Data API spends credits
sections.title_zh: Project API 消耗产品额度，Data API 消耗积分
sections.en: Both APIs use the unified key but serve different jobs. Project API creates/manages account workflows and consumes the existing keyword/audit limits; exceeding them returns an error without extra charges. Data API serves research independently of projects, charges successful2xx responses according to endpoint/size and returns403 Insufficient Funds at zero balance. Rolling one-second rates are5requests for Project and10 for Data, with Data trial limited to1. Async polling counts too. Editorial integration: identify which meter applies before automating a job and handle quota exhaustion separately from429 rate limits. Documentation access does not establish successful authentication or safe mutation scope.
sections.zh: 两种 API 共用统一 key，但职责不同。Project API 建／管账户流程，消耗已有关键词／审计额度，超额报错不额外计费。Data API 独立于项目供研究，按端点／响应量收费成功2xx，余额零返403 Insufficient Funds。滚动一秒限额 Project 为5次、Data 为10次，Data 试用为1次，异步轮询也计。编辑集成：自动运行前确定计量器，区分额度耗尽与429限流。读到文档不等于已成功认证或验证修改范围。

sections.title_en: Current plan authority matters when older help text disagrees
sections.title_zh: 旧帮助文冲突时先确认当前套餐权威
sections.en: Current pricing and billing describe Agency Pack as a separate annual add-on for eligible annual plans; the older account FAQ’s no-separate-purchase white-label statement cannot establish entitlement for a new Core account. Paid-plan limits and trial limits also differ: the trial FAQ explicitly excludes MCP despite broad full-access wording. The browser showed dollar prices while the public reader showed EUR for the same page. Editorial purchase preparation: retain the chosen currency, billing period, actual account generation, add-ons and checkout quote; do not convert currencies or reuse historical plan labels to fill missing terms.
sections.zh: 当前价格及账单文将 Agency Pack 写为合资格年付套餐的独立年付附加项；旧账户 FAQ 的白标无需另购不能确定新 Core 权限。付费与试用限额也不同，试用 FAQ 明确不含 MCP，即使营销写完整访问。相同页面实际浏览器显示美元数值、公开读取显示欧元。编辑采购准备：保所选币种、期间、真实账户代际、附加项及结账报价，不换算币种或套旧套餐名补未知条件。

sections.title_en: Cancel renewal, bundled extras and data deletion separately
sections.title_zh: 分别处理续订、捆绑附加项及数据删除
sections.en: Cancellation requires the final Billing confirmation; it disables renewal while retaining access through the paid period. Bundled add-ons follow the main plan, while separately invoiced add-ons need separate cancellation; annual add-ons may require Support. The dedicated guide says projects remain inactive for60days after expiration. The no-card trial does not automatically become paid. Account deletion is a separate irreversible step. Editorial exit: check invoice grouping, cancellation confirmation and required exports before the paid period ends, and avoid assuming that stopping one line item cancels every independent subscription.
sections.zh: 取消需在 Billing 最后确认，关闭续订但保留已付期内访问。捆绑附加项跟随主套餐，独立发票的附加项需另取消，年付附加项可能需支持处理。专门指南称到期后项目停用保60天，免卡试用不自动转付费。删账户是另一个不可逆步骤。编辑退出：付费期结束前核发票分组、最终取消确认及所需导出，不假定停一项就取消全部独立订阅。

seo.title_en: SE Ranking: current plans, tracking scope, AI metrics and audit workflow
seo.title_zh: SE Ranking：当前套餐、跟踪范围、AI 指标及审计流程
seo.description_en: Review SE Ranking tracking units, AI match rules, audits, client reporting, API meters and exit conditions using official sources.
seo.description_zh: 用官方来源核查 SE Ranking 跟踪计量、AI 匹配、审计、客户报告、API 计费及退出条件。
seo.primary_intent: Evaluate current SE Ranking monitoring and client-delivery workflows
secondary_questions: How are keyword and prompt units counted?
Why do Sources and Rankings disagree?
What transfers between SE Ranking accounts?
seo.query_basis: Editorial intent; no search volume, ranking or AI visibility measured.

research_gaps.en: Actual account operations, rank/AI accuracy, permissions, report delivery and API authentication were not tested.
research_gaps.zh: 未实测账户操作、排名／AI 准确性、权限、报告投递或 API 认证。

research_gaps.zh: 准确第五跟踪 LLM、提示词名额与检查量对应关系、冲突默认抓取速度仍需厂商澄清。

research_gaps.zh: 地区最终报价／税、HTML／访客链接过期／密码、完整备份及数据恢复成功未核。
